label: Week 6
method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-13T01:08Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Tuesday of Week 6, stamped vibe week reg-6. Volume landed for all 32 clubs. Loudest rooms: BUF, LAR, BAL, DEN, SF, CHI, PHI, DAL, CLE, NE. BUF volume is inflated by the MNF OT win and Hailee Steinfeld clips; NYJ count includes non-NFL #Jets noise (Newcastle Jets). HOU, JAX, LV, NE pools were mostly other clubs, college, NBA, F1 or soccer, so their kept items come from other clubs' pools where they were participants. Dropped mostly college football (Red River, Penn State/Campbell, Colorado/Deion, Cal/Kentucky/Coastal uniforms, bowl projections, Georgia-Alabama), MLB/NBA/NHL/F1/NASCAR/WNBA/A-League, fan fight and QB tier lists, Hailee Steinfeld and Lacy streamer clips, Kelce 'we' broadcast chatter, Big Dom politics, Hulu Browns show, Bernie Kosar Day nostalgia, Jerry Jones Lambeau flash story, Madden card, HILL 10 stadium-board gag, SEA/SF trophy trash talk, Tirico flex idea, and heavy cross-club near-dupes.

items.title: LaFleur keeps staff, Beck activation discussed
items.one_line: After the 45-21 loss to Detroit, LaFleur ruled out staff or play-calling changes (DC Nick Rallis stays) and said the team will discuss activating rookie QB Carson Beck from emergency status for the Rams game.

items.title: Lions doubled McBride and Wilson post-MHJ trade
items.one_line: LaFleur said Detroit doubled Trey McBride and Michael Wilson nearly every snap in the first game after Marvin Harrison Jr. was traded to Houston for 2027 second- and sixth-round picks.

items.title: Murray 3-0 in Minnesota as Cards sit 1-4
items.one_line: Kyler Murray's hot start with the Vikings keeps the comparison running while Arizona is 1-4 under Jacoby Brissett and 3-28 in its last 31 without Murray.

items.title: OT loss to Baltimore after Penix rib injury
items.one_line: Atlanta blew a late lead and lost 30-23 in OT; Tua Tagovailoa came in for Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) and threw the walk-off pick to Kyle Hamilton.

items.title: Bijan vs. Gibbs debate
items.one_line: Bijan Robinson leads the league with 580 rushing yards at 5.7 a carry, fueling a Robinson-vs-Gibbs top-back argument.

items.title: Chris Moore cut to make room for Ja'Kobi Lane
items.one_line: Baltimore released WR Chris Moore so rookie Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist, Week 1) can return from IR; Lane practices Wednesday ahead of Cleveland.

items.title: Locker-room footage with Lamar on the sideline
items.one_line: The Ravens released postgame footage from the 30-23 OT win in Atlanta, with an ankle-injured Lamar Jackson hyping teammates after Tyler Huntley's comeback.

items.title: Hamilton quote reopens Harbaugh debate
items.one_line: Kyle Hamilton's 'that's a game that we lose' line after the OT win has fans arguing over whether it was a dig at the John Harbaugh era.

items.title: DJ Moore ruled out, ironman streak ends
items.one_line: DJ Moore (aggravated AC joint sprain, left shoulder) was ruled out 90 minutes before the Rams game, ending a 92-game streak; Trent Sherfield was elevated.

items.title: Allen's 210/121 OT game for win No. 100
items.one_line: Josh Allen threw for 210 and ran for 121 in a 37-34 OT win at the Rams, his 100th career win, as Buffalo moved to 4-1.

items.title: Brady warns Cook on fumbles
items.one_line: Joe Brady said James Cook's ball security (two fumbles Monday, four on the year) could cost him carries if it doesn't improve.

items.title: Practice windows for Moton and Wharton
items.one_line: Carolina opened 21-day windows for RT Taylor Moton (blood clots) and DT Tershawn Wharton (neck surgery); Trevor Etienne is back from an ankle and Cam Jackson went to IR before the Eagles trip.

items.title: Caleb Williams on track for Falcons game
items.one_line: Caleb Williams (Grade 2 hamstring) is back at limited practice and tracking to return Sunday vs. Atlanta after Tyson Bagent was benched in the Lambeau loss.

items.title: 31-7 loss at Green Bay
items.one_line: Green Bay forced five turnovers and held Chicago to 246 yards; Bagent went 12 of 21 for 87 with two picks before Case Keenum took over.

items.title: Tanner Hudson out for season
items.one_line: TE Tanner Hudson tore a pectoral in the 31-24 win at Miami; rookies Jack Endries and Erick All Jr. back up Gesicki and Sample.

items.title: Kiser claimed, Bozeman to IR
items.one_line: Cincinnati claimed LB Jack Kiser off waivers from Jacksonville and put Swayze Bozeman (broken forearm) on IR for at least four weeks.

items.title: Chase's celebration fines rescinded
items.one_line: The NFL overturned Ja'Marr Chase's two Week 2 celebration fines on appeal.

items.title: Estime signed, Sanders to IR
items.one_line: Cleveland promoted RB Audric Estime from Minnesota's practice squad and put Raheim Sanders (hip) on IR, with Quinshon Judkins dealing with an ankle before Baltimore.

items.title: Browns shopping Jerry Jeudy
items.one_line: Cleveland is seeking a third- or fourth-round pick for Jeudy, who has eight catches this year behind the rookie receivers.

items.title: Mike Pettine hired as senior defensive assistant
items.one_line: After a 2-3 start and a players-only meeting, Dallas added Pettine to support DC Christian Parker, who moves to the booth.

items.title: Jerry Jones backs fan's 'embarrassing' yell at Dak
items.one_line: Jones said he has no problem with the tunnel heckle at Dak Prescott after the 24-16 home loss to Tampa Bay.

items.title: Bland and Carson sent home ill
items.one_line: CBs DaRon Bland and Caelen Carson missed Monday's practice with an illness going through the team ahead of Green Bay.

items.title: Surtain and Hufanga miss second straight day
items.one_line: Pat Surtain II and Talanoa Hufanga (both ankles) did not practice again Tuesday and look doubtful for TNF vs. Seattle; Riley Moss (ribs) was limited.

items.title: Bo Nix scrutiny after 123-yard win
items.one_line: Nix went 16 of 27 for 123 in the 23-17 win over the Chargers, and critics are questioning his fifth-year option.

items.title: Campbell's game ball for Dan Miller
items.one_line: Dan Campbell gave the game ball from the 45-21 win over Arizona to radio voice Dan Miller after his wife's death; Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 151 and two scores.

items.title: Gibbs vs. Bijan debate
items.one_line: Gibbs has 504 rushing, 243 receiving and nine total TDs through five games, fueling the top-back argument.

items.title: Jameson Williams fines rescinded
items.one_line: The NFL fully rescinded $26,867 in Week 2 gesture fines against Jameson Williams on appeal.

items.title: Hargrave out for season after rout
items.one_line: The 31-7 win over Chicago came with Javon Hargrave's season-ending torn Achilles.

items.title: Parsons not practicing yet
items.one_line: Micah Parsons (ACL recovery) won't return to practice this week before Sunday night's game against Dallas.

items.title: Love among passing leaders
items.one_line: Jordan Love threw for 367 and two scores vs. Chicago despite a league-high 37 QB hits taken.

items.title: Harrison Jr. acquired from Arizona
items.one_line: Houston traded 2027 second- and sixth-round picks to Arizona for WR Marvin Harrison Jr.

items.title: 26-3 win at Tennessee snaps skid
items.one_line: C.J. Stroud threw for 261 and ran for a score as Houston snapped a four-game skid to get to 1-4.

items.title: Quenton Nelson trade buzz
items.one_line: With extension talks stalled, contenders like Philadelphia and Minnesota are named as fits for Nelson before the deadline.

items.title: Pharaoh Brown promoted, Pratt back on PS
items.one_line: Indy signed TE Pharaoh Brown to the 53 and brought LB Germaine Pratt back on the practice squad ahead of the Titans.

items.title: Little's 57-yarder beats Philly in London
items.one_line: Ameer Abdullah's 53-yard kickoff return set up Cam Little's walk-off 57-yard field goal as Jacksonville moved to 4-1.

items.title: Watson back, Thornton to IR
items.one_line: KC re-signed Justin Watson to the practice squad after putting Tyquan Thornton (ankle) on IR; Rashee Rice has a hamstring issue before the Chargers.

items.title: Routed 45-17 at New England, Mendoza debuts
items.one_line: Drake Maye threw four TDs and ran for one against Las Vegas; rookie Fernando Mendoza went 6 of 8 in late relief of Kirk Cousins.

items.title: Chargers shut down Herbert trade talk
items.one_line: At 0-5, team sources say trading Justin Herbert has never been discussed; he has a full no-trade clause.

items.title: Injury pile-up after Broncos loss
items.one_line: Harbaugh said Tre' Harris is week-to-week (hamstring), Quentin Johnston is limited (chest) and Joe Alt is seeing a specialist for a neck issue; McConkey dressed but didn't play.

items.title: Grimm signed, JuJu worked out
items.one_line: LAC added Luke Grimm to the practice squad and worked out JuJu Smith-Schuster and Ronnie Bell before facing KC.

items.title: Mevis cut, Grupe signed
items.one_line: A day after the blocked kick in the OT loss to Buffalo, the Rams released Harrison Mevis and signed Blake Grupe from the Jets' practice squad.

items.title: 37-34 OT loss to Buffalo
items.one_line: Stafford threw for 383 and three TDs, but the Rams fell to 2-3 in a game with six lead changes.

items.title: Fans say Stafford is locked on Nacua
items.one_line: Viewers complained Stafford forced throws to Puka Nacua in coverage while Davante Adams was open.

items.title: Bye-week moves: Wayne claimed, Miller waived
items.one_line: Miami claimed WR Jared Wayne off waivers from Houston, waived Ryan Miller and swapped practice-squad DL.

items.title: Hafley sticks with Willis after loss to Cincy
items.one_line: Jeff Hafley affirmed Malik Willis as the starter after two Jordan Battle picks in the 31-24 home loss to Cincinnati.

items.title: Jennings frustration and trade talk
items.one_line: WR Jauan Jennings (two catches in five games) confronted O'Connell on the sideline, and the 49ers are named as a trade fit.

items.title: JuJu workout with Addison hurt
items.one_line: Minnesota worked out JuJu Smith-Schuster with Jordan Addison injured; no signing yet.

items.title: Flores memo unsealed in lawsuit
items.one_line: A Korn Ferry memo from the Raiders' search on DC Brian Flores drew racial-bias claims from his lawyers.

items.title: Henderson out multiple weeks
items.one_line: TreVeyon Henderson has a high ankle sprain (no surgery); New England promoted RB Hassan Haskins and CB D'Shawn Jamison before the Jets.

items.title: Maye's five-TD day vs. Raiders
items.one_line: Drake Maye went 26 of 34 for 374 and four TDs plus a rushing score in the 45-17 rout.

items.title: Gayle Benson calls out 1-4 start
items.one_line: Benson said a 1-4 record isn't acceptable and laid out accountability for Kellen Moore, Mickey Loomis and the players.

items.title: Price waived after kickoff fumble
items.one_line: New Orleans waived CB Jayden Price after his fumble vs. Minnesota, cut WR Brock Rechsteiner and LS Cal Adomitis, and re-signed Decamerion Richardson.

items.title: 27-27 tie at Washington
items.one_line: Jameis Winston, in for an injured Jaxson Dart, threw for 326 and three TDs to rally from 14 down; New York is 3-1-1 atop the NFC East.

items.title: Zvada 2-for-5 in the rain
items.one_line: Undrafted rookie K Dominic Zvada missed from 50, 57 and the 46-yard OT winner; Harbaugh backed him.

items.title: Judon workout, Bell signed to PS
items.one_line: With Joseph Ossai nursing an ankle, the Jets worked out Matthew Judon, Quinton Bell and Cam Sample, then signed Bell to the practice squad before New England.

items.title: Barkley and Smith could return vs. Carolina
items.one_line: Sirianni is hopeful Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith (hamstrings) play Sunday; Will Shipley (plantar fascia) is out and Landon Dickerson could return.

items.title: Fangio: Hunt needs 'a miracle'
items.one_line: Vic Fangio said Jalyx Hunt (ankle, knee) needs a miracle to play this week and that Campbell and Trotter will split LB reps.

items.title: Sirianni owns the London kickoff call
items.one_line: Sirianni said 'I lost us that game' after the in-bounds kickoff set up Jacksonville's walk-off field goal; Philly is 2-3 on a three-game skid.

items.title: Warren's historic dual-TD game
items.one_line: Jaylen Warren had a 50-yard rushing TD and 80-yard receiving TD in the 34-22 win over Indy and was named the featured back with Rico Dowdle nearing a return.

items.title: Trump visit to Steelers-Bucs scrapped
items.one_line: CNN reported Trump planned to attend Sunday's Steelers-Bucs game; the trip was called off after the report.

items.title: Seahawks injury report before TNF
items.one_line: Zach Charbonnet (knee) is limited and not expected to debut; Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) is limited but expected to play; Drake Thomas and Chazz Surratt sat.

items.title: Kupp spot controversy in loss to SF
items.one_line: Replay upheld the late fourth-and-10 spot short on Cooper Kupp in the 32-29 loss to San Francisco.

items.title: Irv Charles activated from IR
items.one_line: Seattle activated special-teams WR Irv Charles and moved Velus Jones Jr. to the practice squad before Denver.

items.title: Deebo out 2+ weeks, WR room thin
items.one_line: Deebo Samuel (hamstring) is out at least a couple of weeks, Ricky Pearsall is done for the year (PCL), and Bosa and Juszczyk have a shot to return for MNF vs. Washington.

items.title: Purdy MVP favorite, Greenlaw suspended
items.one_line: Purdy moved to +250 MVP favorite on FanDuel after the 32-29 win at Seattle; Dre Greenlaw got a one-game suspension he's appealing.

items.title: WR trade buzz at 5-0
items.one_line: Analysts are pushing SF toward Terry McLaurin, Garrett Wilson or Brian Thomas Jr. before the Nov. 10 deadline.

items.title: Bucs top PFF pass protection
items.one_line: PFF has Tampa Bay first in true pass sets with an 18.4% pressure rate allowed; Tristan Wirfs grades elite.

items.title: Trump visit to Steelers-Bucs scrapped
items.one_line: CNN reported Trump planned to attend Sunday's Steelers-Bucs game; the trip was called off after the report.

items.title: CEO Burke Nihill under fire at 0-5
items.one_line: Insiders question CEO Burke Nihill after three senior business execs were fired; he's no longer listed on the team website.

items.title: 0-5 after 26-3 home loss to Houston
items.one_line: Cam Ward was 23 of 36 for 170 with four sacks and pushed back on a 'loser' question; Saleh urged patience.

items.title: Parsons rips Daniels' OT clock blunder
items.one_line: Micah Parsons said Jayden Daniels' scramble that ran out the clock in the 27-27 tie could cost Dan Quinn his job; Daniels and Quinn both took blame.

items.title: Devin Neal signed to practice squad
items.one_line: Washington added ex-Saints RB Devin Neal after losing two backs on waivers.

items.title: McLaurin named in SF trade talk
items.one_line: At 1-3-1, Terry McLaurin is getting floated as a 49ers trade target before next Monday's meeting.
